function.name: search_holy_books
function.description: Search content, chapters or authors of holy books. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book.description: The name of the holy book.

chapter.description: The chapter number, if relevant. Default: 3

content.description: Specific content to look for, if relevant.

message.content:
A **holy book** (also called a sacred text) is a collection of writings considered divine, authoritative, and central to the beliefs, practices, and moral teachings of a particular religion or spiritual tradition. These texts are often regarded as revealed scripture—words believed to come from a deity, prophet, or higher spiritual source—and they serve several key purposes:

| Purpose | Typical Functions |
|---------|-------------------|
| **Revelation** | Communicates divine will, commandments, or truths. |
| **Law & Ethics** | Provides guidance on how followers should live, what is right or wrong. |
| **History & Identity** | Records foundational stories, genealogies, and cultural heritage. |
| **Ritual & Worship** | Contains liturgies, prayers, and instructions for religious rites. |
| **Spiritual Insight** | Offers wisdom, parables, or meditative material for personal growth. |

Examples include the Bible (Christianity), Qur’an (Islam), Vedas (Hinduism), Torah (Judaism), Tripitaka (Buddhism), and many others. Each tradition treats its holy book(s) with reverence, using them as a guide for faith, community cohesion, and moral conduct.
